messages:
Lara (People Ops): Quick FYI for managers filling out review forms this cycle: we've added three explicit flags to handle edge cases (LOA, mid-cycle hires, contractor->FTE). Asking managers to use them so calibration sees consistent context.
Tom (Eng Manager): Appreciate the clarity. Two quick asks: (1) can the flag be a required dropdown so people don't forget, and (2) what's the LOA cutoff?
Lara (People Ops): Yes to dropdown. LOA heuristic: >30% of the review window = Partial data (LOA). We'll prefill dates from HRIS when available; managers can edit.
Elena (PM Manager): For new hires <90 days, do we auto-default them to 'New hire' or let managers pick? I sometimes have enough signal to comment but not to give a final rating.
Raj (HRBP): Auto-default to 'New hire <90d' but managers can still add an observational comment. If manager assigns a rating, they must check "Flag for calibration". All provisional ratings will be surfaced and discussed.
Tom (Eng Manager): Can we also have a hidden flag for "PIP during cycle" so calibration reviewers know without exposing details in the main rationale?
Lara (People Ops): Good idea. We'll add a non-public checkbox "PIP during cycle" that only calibration/HR can see.
Elena (PM Manager): Evidence links please 68f allowing 0-5 links. Helps calibration read context quickly.
Lara (People Ops): Yep forms will accept multiple evidence links and a required 1-line rationale. We'll also add a short guidance blurb next to the rating field: "If >30% LOA or conversion occurred, select the appropriate flag and add context. Provisional ratings must be flagged."
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Review forms due in 48 hours. Forms: https://docs.internal/redwood/reviews/forms. Request exceptions: https://helpdesk.internal/redwood/review-exceptions :bell:
Raj (HRBP): Operational note: managers can request a 7-day extension via Helpdesk. For emergency exceptions (manager on LOA), escalate to your HRBP and mark "Requested extension" on the draft form so People Ops can triage.
Tom (Eng Manager): Perfect. One last thing: can the form auto-check "Flag for calibration" when Partial (LOA) or Contractor->FTE is selected? Saves misses.
Lara (People Ops): We'll auto-check by default but allow managers to uncheck with a short confirmation. I'll roll the update tonight and send a one-pager with examples. Ping me if you want a 5-min walkthrough before I publish. :thumbsup:
